description: This file defines a custom exception class 'JobIsNotFoundOrNotEnabledException' for the Apache Fineract project. It extends 'AbstractPlatformException' and provides constructors to indicate that a specific job was not found or not enabled.

classes.name: JobIsNotFoundOrNotEnabledException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a specific job is either not found or not enabled within the system.

methods.name: JobIsNotFoundOrNotEnabledException
methods.description: Constructor accepting an Exception and a job name, indicating the job is not found or disabled.

methods.name: JobIsNotFoundOrNotEnabledException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a job name, indicating the job is not found or disabled.
